mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 500K units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 500K.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during FEDFUNDS < 0.5% periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Interactions between rising employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signal a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals reduced supply chain pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 during tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth above 2% signals robust aggregate demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interactions between rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increasing consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signal tightening financial conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.5% and CPIAUCSL > 210.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6% signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during UNRATE < 6% periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) in late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) growth above 5% signals strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, with increased confidence during holiday seasons.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this mechanism during holiday seasons remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
